title: Tinyland hiring-application intake envelope (hiring-application/v1)
description: Versioned payload shape for a hiring/application intake submitted from a spoke's careers role pages. The in-band `envelope` const is the seam a later dashboard/platform ingester routes on; nothing downstream is built until ratified (see docs/patterns/hiring-application-intake.md, follow-up debt). SSOT home for this shape is the planned @tummycrypt/hiring-form-kit package versioned through tinyland-inc/bazel-registry; until that registry version exists, this file is the pattern-plane reference copy and the app-side zod schema of the first consumer (MassageIthaca src/lib/hiring/schema.ts) is authored to match it. Transport-plane fields (the honeypot decoy, CSRF/session material) are NEVER part of the envelope: they are consumed and discarded by the handler before the envelope is constructed. Resume/file transport is an explicitly open decision (attachment vs link vs defer) and is deliberately absent from v1; adding it is an additive change gated on that decision, made before the kit freezes v1 in the registry.

envelope.description: Envelope discriminator + version. Consumers and any future ingester MUST match this exactly; a shape change bumps the version, never mutates v1 in place once registered.

role.description: Role slug from the consumer's own role catalog (the careers route segment). The catalog (allowed enum + display titles) is consumer-side app-schema truth, not envelope truth: the first consumer pins `licensed-massage-therapist` and `patient-practice-coordinator`. The envelope only bounds the shape.

applicant.description: Who is applying. `email` is the submitterEmail that threads through delivery as Reply-To (never From) and through the internal-submitter guards; recipient resolution NEVER derives from any field in this envelope.

phone.description: Optional. Free-form bounded string; no format coercion in the envelope.

letter.description: The brief letter the posting requires (interest / intent / fit). Bounded so the delivery mail and any future ingest stay small; the body cap on the transport is separate and also mandatory.

references.description: Exactly two professional work references, per the posting's requirements.

contact.description: How to reach the reference (email or phone), free-form bounded string.
